title: AZ-900 · Describe cloud service types · Summary

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.question: Which statement best describes Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)?

options.text: A cloud model that rents infrastructure while giving the customer the most control over operating systems and software
The cloud provider patches and maintains the underlying operating system
The lowest customer operational overhead among IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
A managed environment that lets developers build applications without maintaining the full development infrastructure

questions.explanation: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) is a cloud model that rents infrastructure while giving the customer the most control over operating systems and software.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does IaaS provider responsibility refer to?

options.text: The high level of customer control that comes with greater operational responsibility
The lowest customer operational overhead among IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
Maintaining physical hardware, physical security, and internet connectivity
Using complete productivity software delivered as a cloud service

questions.explanation: IaaS provider responsibility is maintaining physical hardware, physical security, and internet connectivity.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.question: Which description correctly matches IaaS customer operating-system responsibility?

options.text: A cloud model that rents infrastructure while giving the customer the most control over operating systems and software
Managing most of the infrastructure, platform, application maintenance, and updates
Moving workloads to cloud infrastructure with minimal redesign
Installing, configuring, patching, and maintaining the guest operating system

questions.explanation: IaaS customer operating-system responsibility is installing, configuring, patching, and maintaining the guest operating system.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.question: Which of the following is the best definition of IaaS customer network configuration?

options.text: Configuring much of the workload networking and security settings above the physical layer
Platform features such as scalability and high availability that reduce the amount of infrastructure code a team must manage
The lowest customer operational overhead among IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
Typically less infrastructure customization than IaaS or PaaS

questions.explanation: IaaS customer network configuration is configuring much of the workload networking and security settings above the physical layer.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.question: What is the primary meaning of Lift-and-shift migration in Azure fundamentals?

options.text: The lowest customer operational overhead among IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
Application code, data, and access controls rather than physical infrastructure
A managed environment that lets developers build applications without maintaining the full development infrastructure
Moving workloads to cloud infrastructure with minimal redesign

questions.explanation: Lift-and-shift migration is moving workloads to cloud infrastructure with minimal redesign.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: IaaS provider responsibility: maintaining physical hardware, physical security, and internet connectivity.
IaaS customer operating-system responsibility: the cloud provider manages middleware and managed runtime components.
IaaS provider responsibility: the high level of customer control that comes with greater operational responsibility.
Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS): configuring much of the workload networking and security settings above the physical layer.
Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS): a cloud model that rents infrastructure while giving the customer the most control over operating systems and software.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) — a cloud model that rents infrastructure while giving the customer the most control over operating systems and software; and IaaS provider responsibility — maintaining physical hardware, physical security, and internet connectivity.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.question: Which TWO statements accurately reflect the concepts covered in this unit?

options.text: IaaS customer network configuration: configuring much of the workload networking and security settings above the physical layer.
IaaS customer network configuration: the cloud provider patches and maintains the underlying operating system.
IaaS customer network configuration: a managed environment that lets developers build applications without maintaining the full development infrastructure.
IaaS customer operating-system responsibility: rapidly creating and removing environments while retaining detailed configuration control.
IaaS customer operating-system responsibility: installing, configuring, patching, and maintaining the guest operating system.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: IaaS customer operating-system responsibility — installing, configuring, patching, and maintaining the guest operating system; and IaaS customer network configuration — configuring much of the workload networking and security settings above the physical layer.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.question: Select TWO correct statements about the material in this Microsoft Learn unit.

options.text: IaaS dev/test use case: a managed environment that lets developers build applications without maintaining the full development infrastructure.
IaaS dev/test use case: rapidly creating and removing environments while retaining detailed configuration control.
Lift-and-shift migration: a cloud model in which the provider manages infrastructure and platform components while the customer focuses on applications and data.
Lift-and-shift migration: using managed analytics or business-intelligence platforms to extract insights without running the underlying platform.
Lift-and-shift migration: moving workloads to cloud infrastructure with minimal redesign.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Lift-and-shift migration — moving workloads to cloud infrastructure with minimal redesign; and IaaS dev/test use case — rapidly creating and removing environments while retaining detailed configuration control.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.question: Which TWO statements are consistent with the unit content?

options.text: IaaS flexibility: the cloud provider manages middleware and managed runtime components.
IaaS flexibility: the high level of customer control that comes with greater operational responsibility.
IaaS dev/test use case: application code, data, and access controls rather than physical infrastructure.
Platform as a Service (PaaS): a cloud model in which the provider manages infrastructure and platform components while the customer focuses on applications and data.
Platform as a Service (PaaS): application code, data, and access controls rather than physical infrastructure.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: IaaS flexibility — the high level of customer control that comes with greater operational responsibility; and Platform as a Service (PaaS) — a cloud model in which the provider manages infrastructure and platform components while the customer focuses on applications and data.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.question: Choose the TWO accurate statements.

options.text: PaaS middleware management: the cloud provider manages middleware and managed runtime components.
IaaS flexibility: platform features such as scalability and high availability that reduce the amount of infrastructure code a team must manage.
PaaS operating-system management: using managed analytics or business-intelligence platforms to extract insights without running the underlying platform.
PaaS middleware management: a model in which customers use a complete cloud-hosted application.
PaaS operating-system management: the cloud provider patches and maintains the underlying operating system.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: PaaS operating-system management — the cloud provider patches and maintains the underlying operating system; and PaaS middleware management — the cloud provider manages middleware and managed runtime components.
